run_pump_code_generation: run pump.py on a .pump source file to generate repetitive C++ boilerplate code
parse_pump_ast: parse Pump source text into an AST using ParseToAST for meta programming analysis
convert_pump_source: convert Pump template source text to generated output code using ConvertFromPumpSource
tokenize_pump_code: tokenize Pump source code into tokens using the Tokenize generator function
beautify_generated_code: beautify generated code output by wrapping long lines with BeautifyCode
